subject: general
question: Who was the author of the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharishi Veda Vyasa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Maharishi Veda Vyasa** is traditionally credited as the author of the Mahabharata, one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India.
 
• He is also known as **Krishna Dvaipayana Vyasa** because of his dark complexion and his birthplace on an island.
 
• Veda Vyasa is considered a central and revered figure in most Hindu traditions, and he is also regarded as a partial incarnation of the god Vishnu.
 
• Besides the Mahabharata, he is also credited with compiling the Vedas and writing the Puranas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahabharata**

 
 
• The Mahabharata is one of the largest epic tales ever written, consisting of approximately 100,000 shlokas or over 200,000 individual verse lines.
 
• It narrates the Kurukshetra War between the Kauravas and the Pandavas and encompasses various philosophical and devotional material, including a discussion of the four "goals of life" (purusharthas).
 
• One of the most significant parts of the Mahabharata is the **Bhagavad Gita**, a 700-verse Hindu scripture that is part of the Indian epic Mahabharata.
 
• The Mahabharata has had a profound influence on Indian culture and spirituality and continues to be a crucial source of moral and ethical guidance.
 
 
 
• **Vedas**
 
 
• The Vedas are a large body of religious texts originating in ancient India. They constitute the oldest layer of Sanskrit literature and the oldest scriptures of Hinduism.
 
• There are four Vedas: Rigveda, Samaveda, Yajurveda, and Atharvaveda.
 
• Veda Vyasa is traditionally credited with compiling the Vedas, ensuring their preservation and propagation.
 
 
 
• **Puranas**
 
 
• The Puranas are ancient Hindu texts eulogizing various deities, primarily the divine Trimurti God in Hinduism through divine stories.
 
• Veda Vyasa is also attributed with writing the Puranas, which include the famous Vishnu Purana, Bhagavata Purana, and others.
 
• The Puranas cover topics such as cosmogony, cosmology, genealogies of gods, heroes, and sages, folk tales, pilgrimages, temples, medicine, astronomy, grammar, and ritual.
